dct_title_s: Metered Parking Spaces, Cambridge, Massachusetts, October 2009
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This polygon layer contains metered street parking spaces in the City of Cambridge.
Purpose: Created for use with online permitting for street obstructions (moving vans, dumpsters, etc.) and for the Traffic and Parking Department for parking meter inventory.
dct_creator_sm: Cambridge (Mass.). Dept. of Traffic and Parking
